page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.14xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 56 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing 56 vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 224.0 GB of RAM, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, and relies on a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. Virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark data reveals a clear divergence between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core metrics are relatively weak, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression scoring in the bottom 10%. However, the high core count compensates in parallelized tasks. Multi-core stress-ng, Geekbench multi-core, and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression all register in the middle 50% tier. Memory bandwidth is stable, with read-only small block cached transfers reaching 2284.31 GB/sec and uncached large block writes at 50.54 GB/sec, both aligning with average tier performance.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn2ne.14xlarge offers a high density of dedicated legacy Intel cores, making it suitable for workloads that scale horizontally rather than relying on high single-thread speed. Tradeoffs include the lack of local NVMe storage and lower single-core efficiency compared to newer processor generations. This hardware profile is suited for multi-threaded workloads such as static web serving, software compilation, database operations, and moderate multi-threaded data processing where parallel execution can offset the lower single-core performance.
